findingDetails.title: Phase 026's commit/provenance state is contradictory across its own summary and the roadmap
findingDetails.evidence: Phase summary says committed at 1bac3c2 while roadmap says no commit and working tree holds the check; N5 is still pending.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reconcile parent and phase provenance to one commit/tree and record the clean N5 result or open status consistently.

findingDetails.title: The shared surface registry has an unproven equality boundary
findingDetails.evidence: The type-closed registry declares five producers while the phase inventory describes 33 positioner call sites and 11 owned menus.
findingDetails.recommendation: Complete the census-to-registry equality check or mark the remaining producers as intentionally outside the registry.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Shared surface contract and its phase census are in target scope.
